軟.meaning: A <part>car</part> lets out an enormous <part>yawn</part> in the car park, and its whole body goes floppy: the roof sags, the tyres squish like marshmallows and the doors droop like ears. Kids bounce on it like a bed. It's gone completely <kanji>soft</kanji>.
軟.on: The driver plugs a hole in one tyre with a folded <sound>naan</sound>, and somehow it holds.
軟.kun: '<sound>Yah</sound>!' whoops a kid as he bounces, and the car groans '<sound>Wah</sound>!'

竜.meaning: A lizard eats a whole chilli pepper on a dare. Its tail swishes, wings burst from its shoulders and a puff of fire singes the picnic blanket. It takes off over the hills, roaring with pride. It's a <kanji>dragon</kanji> now.
竜.on: It flies home for the family <sound>reu</sound>nion, and every aunt gasps.
竜.kun: It toasts a <sound>ta</sound>co for each aunt, then lands in the lake with a <sound>tsu</sound>nami.

架.meaning: A beaver wants to <part>add</part> one wonder to the forest, so it props a fallen <part>tree</part> upright, braces it with twigs and fixes crossbeams to it, a tall frame by sunset. The other animals gasp: it found a way to <kanji>erect</kanji> a tower.
架.on: From the top it can see a <sound>ca</sound>rp in the pond far below.
架.kun: It hangs a sign from the frame: 'Stay <sound>ca</sound>lm, it holds.'

粒.meaning: At a tiny parade, every <part>rice</part> kernel is ordered to <part>stand</part> to attention in single file along a chopstick, a million long. An ant general inspects them one by one through a magnifying glass, counting all the <kanji>grains</kanji>.
粒.on: Afterwards they all hop back into the bag for a <sound>reu</sound>nion.
粒.kun: Then a <sound>tsu</sound>nami of spilt soup sweeps them onto a <sound>bu</sound>ll's nose, and he sneezes.

臓.meaning: Under the <part>moon</part>, a toy maker opens his clockwork bear like a <part>storehouse</part>: inside are coiled springs, cogs, a tiny drum for a heart and a tangle of wires. He oils each one by lamplight. Even a toy has <kanji>entrails</kanji>.
臓.on: The bear's heart drum is painted with all the signs of the <sound>zo</sound>diac.
臓.kun: Inside he also finds a <sound>ha</sound>rp string, a <sound>ra</sound>men noodle, a dab of <sound>wa</sound>sabi and a <sound>ta</sound>co shell.

胸.meaning: A <part>villain</part> steals the <part>moon</part> and tries to <part>wrap</part> it in his cloak, but it glows right through. He hugs it close against his chest, where it shines like a lamp. For one night he's gentle, holding the moon to his <kanji>bosom</kanji>.
胸.on: He whispers that he'll take it to <sound>Kyo</sound>to, drawing out the start of the name like a lullaby.
胸.kun: A <sound>moo</sound>se catches him in a <sound>ne</sound>t and hangs the moon back up.

芽.meaning: In spring, an old elephant naps in the <part>grass</part> and wakes to find a tiny green shoot growing from his <part>tusk</part>, with one shy leaf. He carries it proudly for weeks, watering it with his trunk. It's his very first <kanji>bud</kanji>.
芽.on: Then a <sound>ga</sound>rlic bulb starts sprouting from his other tusk.
芽.kun: Next a <sound>me</sound>lon seed sprouts behind his ear, and he waters that too.

砕.meaning: A grumpy troll hates the <part>signpost</part> that keeps pointing tourists to his bridge, so he hurls a <part>stone</part> at it. Crack! It bursts into a hundred splinters. The tourists find him anyway, but it felt good to <kanji>smash</kanji> it.
砕.on: To calm down, he sips a jug of <sound>ci</sound>der under the bridge.
砕.kun: His friend the <sound>coo</sound>k bakes him a <sound>du</sound>ck-shaped pie to cheer him up.

潜.meaning: A spy and a fish <part>exchange</part> clothes so the spy can sneak past the castle guards. In borrowed scales he slips into the moat, sending up a few <part>water drops</part>, and holds his breath. The fish waddles off in a trench coat. The spy must <kanji>submerge</kanji>.
潜.on: The <sound>sen</sound>try on the wall waves at the fish, sure it's the spy.
潜.kun: Down in the moat he hides behind a sunken <sound>hee</sound>l and an old <sound>so</sound>fa.
